title: Junius
html_source:
Junius was the pseudonym of a writer who contributed a series of letters to the Public Advertiser, [London newspaper] from 1769 to 1772…exposing blatant corruption by the only means available (anonymity) in a country struggling with the idea of freedom of speech…The identity of Junius is open to question and debate, and may never be finally resolved unless documents are found which establish his identity.
Wikipedia
